name: Select
description: A field that opens a list of options and keeps one, with icons, avatars, sections and an optional search.

props.name: label
props.description: Label above the trigger.

props.name: description
props.description: Help text under the trigger. Replaced by the error while the field is invalid.

props.name: errorMessage
props.description: Shown under the trigger while the field is invalid, with an alert icon.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Muted text in the trigger while nothing is chosen.

props.name: size
props.description: Trigger height of 32, 36 or 44 pixels, matching Input.

props.name: searchable
props.description: Start the popover with a search field that filters the options, with an empty state.

props.name: searchPlaceholder
props.description: Placeholder and accessible name of the search field.

props.name: items
props.description: Options for a dynamic list. Render each one with a function as children.

props.name: children
props.description: SelectItem and SelectSection elements, or a function that renders one per entry of items.

props.name: value
props.description: The chosen option's id (controlled). Use defaultValue when uncontrolled.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called when the choice changes.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Disables the field and dims it to 50%.

props.name: isInvalid
props.description: Shows the camellia outline and the error message.

props.name: triggerClassName
props.description: Extra classes for the trigger button.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root. Also accepts every other prop of the react-aria-components Select (isRequired, name, isOpen, onOpenChange...).

props.name: id
props.description: Identifies the option in value.

props.name: children
props.description: The label.

props.name: description
props.description: A second, muted line under the label. Not shown in the trigger.

props.name: icon
props.description: A 16 pixel icon before the label.

props.name: avatar
props.description: Image source for a round avatar before the label.

props.name: textValue
props.description: Plain text for typeahead and search. Taken from children when they are a string.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Disables this option.

props.name: title
props.description: The heading above the group.

props.name: items
props.description: Options for a dynamic section. Render each one with a function as children.

props.name: children
props.description: The section's SelectItem elements.
